label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: If God existed, there would be no evil
locator: I q.2 a.3 obj. 1: Si ergo Deus esset, nullum malum inveniretur
interpretation: The objection's conditional, which it derives from a contrariety principle ('if one of two contraries were infinite, the other would be wholly destroyed') and the name 'God' signifying an infinite good. Only the conditional is formalized. Aquinas states the objection to answer it; this claim records what the objection says, not Aquinas' view.
